title: Are you asking the right questions to build your manufacturing data strategy?
summary: In today's fast-paced and highly competitive manufacturing landscape, data has become an essential resource for running a business. Making the most of what’s fast becoming almost unlimited data reserves requires a well-defined data strategy. It can help manufacturers achieve their goals, whether it is to better understand customers, improve operational efficiency and resilience, or drive profitable growth. However, determining the right data strategy for your manufacturing organization can seem daunting.
